reviewScope: Black Whale vessel, spatial, access, operational, structural and scale evidence only

pass1.method: Full-page visual sweep of all 18 ordered pages

pass2.method: Full-resolution verification of royal rooms, corridor thresholds, fixtures, security states and signage

retainedPanels.subject: Royal corridor with repeated suite fronts
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A broad decorated corridor shows repeated tall room fronts and group-width circulation.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact bay spacing

retainedPanels.subject: Mounted 10:27 display
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A fixed wall display reads 10:27 beside a furnished sleeping or treatment zone.
modelingProhibitions: Do not assign an unverified system function

retainedPanels.subject: Guard line in formal interior
retainedPanels.visualDescription: Several guards can form a controlled line across a broad formal room or corridor approach.
modelingProhibitions: Do not model guard positions as permanent architecture

retainedPanels.subject: Room 1003 threshold
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A visible 1003 plaque identifies a corridor-facing royal suite.
modelingProhibitions: Do not infer adjacency from montage order

evidence.claim: A royal suite contains finished wall treatment and a large occupiable interior.
Characters move between a formal room and corridor through a tall paneled doorway.
The corridor has repeated tall fronts, decorative trim and group-width circulation.
A wall-mounted display reads 10:27 inside the suite environment.
A large decorated wall or door fixture occupies a fixed interior boundary.
A bed or couch zone and standing guards coexist inside a large furnished room.
Guards establish a line across a broad royal room or corridor approach.
A 1003 plaque identifies a specific corridor-facing suite entrance.
A large chair and decorative interior elements establish a formal residential room class.
Several occupants can stand abreast while preserving a central route.
Room 1003 uses the established four-digit royal-suite plaque format.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Wall display identity
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: The 10:27 display is a mounted time or status device; its exact system role is unknown.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Room 1003 sequence
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: The plaque identifies one suite but panel order does not prove adjacency to other rooms.

excludedMaterial.reason: Excluded pages do not independently establish ship evidence.
